ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 82

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 17
   C. 21
   D. 15

4. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

6. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 0

7. Solve for x: x + 8 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 8
   C. 12
   D. 4

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

9. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 25

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

11. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 37

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

13. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

14. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 3

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
